subject: ArmPkg,MdePkg,MdeModulePkg: change ArmFfaLibGetVersion() with whole version
reasons: Clear API migration: ArmFfaLibGetVersion() signature changes from (UINT16 major, UINT16 minor, UINT16 *outMajor, UINT16 *outMinor) to (UINT32 version, UINT32 *outVersion), applied consistently across 5 files in 3 packages
High repetitiveness: the same call-site transformation appears multiple times across MmCommunicationDxe, MmCommunicationPei, ArmStandaloneMmCoreEntryPoint, ArmMmuStandaloneMmLib, and ArmFfaCommon

The transformation pattern is well-defined: replace ArmFfaLibGetVersion(ARM_FFA_MAJOR_VERSION, ARM_FFA_MINOR_VERSION, &major, &minor) with ArmFfaLibGetVersion(ARM_FFA_CREATE_VERSION(...), &version); replace subsequent uses of major/minor with ARM_FFA_MAJOR/MINOR_VERSION_GET(version)
Also replaces the two-variable comparison (major != X || minor > Y) with ARM_FFA_ABI_COMPATIBLE(version, X, Y) - a systematic macro migration pattern
candidate_pattern:
@@
UINT16 major;
UINT16 minor;
@@
- ArmFfaLibGetVersion(ARM_FFA_MAJOR_VERSION, ARM_FFA_MINOR_VERSION, &major, &minor)
+ ArmFfaLibGetVersion(ARM_FFA_CREATE_VERSION(ARM_FFA_MAJOR_VERSION, ARM_FFA_MINOR_VERSION), &version)
... replace subsequent major/minor usage with ARM_FFA_MAJOR/MINOR_VERSION_GET(version) and version compatibility checks with ARM_FFA_ABI_COMPATIBLE macro
